IsCheckAudioBitrate.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the audio bitrate. You can specify only one of IsCheckAudioBitrate and IsCheckAudioBitrateFail. IsCheckAudioBitrateFail has a higher priority. Valid values:
true: Check. If the input audio bitrate is lower than the output settings, the input audio bitrate is used for transcoding.
false: Do not check.
Default value:
If the parameter is empty and the codec is different from the input source: false.
If the parameter is empty and the codec is the same as the input source: true
IsCheckAudioBitrate.description_zh:
是否检查音频码率。IsCheckAudioBitrate和IsCheckAudioBitrateFail只支持二选一，IsCheckAudioBitrateFail优先级更高。

true：检查。当输入音频码率小于输出设置时，按输入音频码率转码。

false：不检查。

默认值：

参数为空，并且codec和输入源不一样：false。

参数为空，并且codec和输入源一样：true

IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the audio bitrate. You can specify only one of IsCheckAudioBitrate and IsCheckAudioBitrateFail. This parameter has a higher priority. Valid values:
true: Check. If the input audio bitrate is lower than the output settings, a transcoding failure is returned.
false: Do not check.
Default value: false
IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_zh:
是否检查音频码率。IsCheckAudioBitrate和IsCheckAudioBitrateFail只支持二选一，本参数优先级更高。

true：检查。当输入音频码率小于输出设置时，返回转码失败。

false：不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckReso.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the video resolution. You can specify only one of IsCheckReso and IsCheckResoFail. IsCheckResoFail has a higher priority. Valid values:
true: Check. If the width or height of the input video resolution is smaller than the output settings, the input video resolution is used for transcoding.
false: Do not check.
Default value: false
IsCheckReso.description_zh:
是否检查视频分辨率。IsCheckReso和IsCheckResoFail只支持二选一，IsCheckResoFail优先级更高。

true：检查。当输入视频分辨率（宽或高）小于输出设置时，按输入视频分辨率转码。

false：不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckResoFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the video resolution. You can specify only one of IsCheckReso and IsCheckResoFail. This parameter has a higher priority. Valid values:
true: Check. If the width or height of the input video resolution is smaller than the output settings, a transcoding failure is returned.
false: Do not check.
Default value: false
IsCheckResoFail.description_zh:

TransMode.description_en:
The video transcoding mode. Valid values:
onepass: Typically used for ABR. The encoding speed is faster than twopass.
twopass: Typically used for VBR. The encoding speed is slower than onepass.

Default value: onepass
TransMode.description_zh:
视频转码模式。取值如下：

onepass：一般用于ABR。编码速度较twopass更快。

twopass：一般用于VBR。编码速度较onepass更慢。

CBR：固定码率模式。

默认值：onepass

IsCheckAudioBitrateFail.description_zh:
是否检查音频码率。IsCheckAudioBitrate和IsCheckAudioBitrateFail只支持二选一，本参数优先级更高。

true：检查。当输入音频码率小于输出设置时，返回转码失败。

false：不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckReso.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the video resolution. You can specify only one of IsCheckReso and IsCheckResoFail. IsCheckResoFail has a higher priority. Valid values:
true: Check. If the width or height of the input video resolution is smaller than the output settings, the input video resolution is used for transcoding.
false: Do not check.
Default value: false
IsCheckReso.description_zh:
是否检查视频分辨率。IsCheckReso和IsCheckResoFail只支持二选一，IsCheckResoFail优先级更高。

true：检查。当输入视频分辨率（宽或高）小于输出设置时，按输入视频分辨率转码。

false：不检查。

默认值：false

IsCheckResoFail.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the video resolution. You can specify only one of IsCheckReso and IsCheckResoFail. This parameter has a higher priority. Valid values:
true: Check. If the width or height of the input video resolution is smaller than the output settings, a transcoding failure is returned.
false: Do not check.
Default value: false
IsCheckResoFail.description_zh:

false: Do not check.
Default value: false

twopass: Typically used for VBR. The encoding speed is slower than onepass.

CBR：固定码率模式。

默认值：onepass
